run_benchmark_flash_attn: run the benchmark_attn script to benchmark flash attention forward and backward passes across multiple backends
benchmark_attention_backends: benchmark flash attention backends including FA2, FA3, FA4, cuDNN, and standard reference implementations
get_peak_device_flops: get the peak BF16 TFLOPS for a CUDA device by querying the GPU name against known NVIDIA spec values
get_peak_device_bandwidth: get the peak HBM bandwidth in bytes/sec for a CUDA device by matching the GPU name against known values
parse_attention_headdims: parse comma-separated headdim specs supporting both single values like 128 and paired values like 192-128
